Stops every channel on a bus and on the buses that feed it. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
StopAudioBus cave
```
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
